scope: Fresh Qwen3.5-0.8B L0 M128 official reference plus separately executed typed full-block cold/carried replay and original-threshold comparison. No prior PASS is inherited.
restrictions: No acquisition, installation, compilation, model capture, replay, or network probe was executed while preparing this plan.
Reuse the already verified 14 original L0 tensors; do not download them again.
Never rewrite historical receipts, relax identity checks or numerical thresholds, or substitute synthetic smoke inputs.
No public weights, input/output tensors, NPZ files, private absolute paths, or text-encoded data. Publish only source, pins, hashes and redacted summaries when separately authorized.
Honor network and filesystem denial. Do not change security settings or inspect denied paths. A sandbox-launch failure is not a download result.

layer0_payload.dtypes: Original BF16 and F32 storage; no cast or quantization.

embedding_acquisition.checks: HTTP 206; Content-Range bytes 70216-594503/1746942600; Content-Length 524288; identity encoding; read at most 524289 bytes; reject size/hash mismatch before writing.
embedding_acquisition.redirect_evidence: Committed HTTP receipt does not retain a verifiable redirect chain or redirect count. Current redirect hosts must be observed and checked; do not guess or reuse expired signed URLs.

byte_only_input_fixture.token_ids: (73*i+19)%256 for i=0..255, copied as unchanged BF16 rows

existing_builder_gaps: Does not install Transformers, huggingface-hub, tokenizers or safetensors.
Receipt uses sha256/wheels, while native/capture.py requires measured artifacts records with path, bytes and sha256.
Downloads Torch again even though its verified wheel is retained. Do not run this builder unmodified.

transformers.bytes_status: Not present in available committed pins; must measure, not estimate.
transformers.redirect_expectation: GitHub archive endpoint normally redirects to codeload.github.com. Exact current Location and HTTPS chain are unverified until a permitted bounded probe.
transformers.installation_provenance: Use the canonical official archive URL with its SHA256 fragment through pip, preserving the genuine direct_url.json. Installing a local ZIP creates file:// provenance and does not satisfy capture.py. Do not edit direct_url.json to manufacture a canonical origin. Reuse pip's verified HTTP cache when available.
transformers.bounded_install_route_status: UNRESOLVED: canonical pip installation can refetch the archive. A separately bounded predownload does not bound that later fetch. Before installation, review an implementation that guarantees total body/dependency bounds while preserving genuine canonical provenance; do not run an unconstrained URL install or assume a cache hit.

dependency_resolution.version_policy: Use a newly pinned and fully recorded dependency set compatible with the unchanged Transformers source. A fresh reference is not byte-identical reproduction of the unavailable historical environment.
dependency_resolution.next_step: Resolve missing wheel and build-backend artifacts from official PyPI metadata, recording exact filename, version, HTTPS URL, bytes and SHA256 before installing. Reuse any local wheel only after exact lock/hash verification. Do not copy the mixed recovered runtime wholesale as qualified.
dependency_resolution.lock_installation: Install verified locked wheels without index/dependency resolution into a fresh isolated site-packages directory; consume TORCH_WHEEL locally. Build/install the hash-verified canonical Transformers archive with a separately locked official build backend and no undeclared dependency fetch.

fresh_qualification_requirements: Actual Python 3.12 interpreter and isolated module paths; no user-site imports; pinned Torch 2.10.0+cpu and commit 449b1768410104d3ed79d3bcfe4ba1d65c7f22c0; NumPy 2.3.5.

ATEN_CPU_CAPABILITY=default before Torch import; one allowed CPU and one intra/inter-op thread; confirm DEFAULT dispatch. No autocast, eval/inference, deterministic algorithms and highest float32 matmul precision for capture.
Verify all four installed official source files, canonical Transformers direct_url URL and archive SHA; verify all installed wheel/source artifacts and dependency consistency.

Generate a new immutable runtime_receipt.json only after actual successful checks, with status PASS_ISOLATED_PINNED_RUNTIME_READY, nonempty measured checks and artifacts mapping each retained provenance artifact to current-root path, byte count and SHA256. This must be a new verifier result, not schema-only repair of an old receipt.

Artifacts must include current wrapper, dependency lock/acquisition/install reports, qualification source/output, exact installed native/source identities and archive provenance. Preserve failures and do not create a ready receipt on failure.
Record that runtime readiness is not an official block capture, candidate result, RTL result or numerical PASS.

bounded_network_test_plan.initial_action: One HTTPS HEAD per canonical artifact endpoint, no automatic redirects, connect timeout 10 seconds, total timeout 30 seconds, at most three redirects inspected one hop at a time. HEAD tests reachability only; it cannot establish payload or range correctness.
bounded_network_test_plan.body_limits: Embedding body only through the existing checked 524288-byte collector; archive acquisition must abort above 134217728 bytes; dependency metadata at most 2097152 bytes per response before lock resolution.
bounded_network_test_plan.provenance: Record canonical URL, UTC time, status, sanitized redirect hostname/path, declared/measured length and exact hash. Never retain signed query strings or credentials in public plans/reports.
bounded_network_test_plan.failure_rule: Stop the denied operation; preserve the exact action/target/error and whether anything executed. No security-setting changes, denied-path reads, alternate-route bypass, automatic escalation retry or claim of acquisition on sandbox-launch failure.

current_root_matrix.reason: Existing ELF/source bytes match but the old compile argv is bound to another checkout root. Do not edit its receipt.
current_root_matrix.compiler: Existing trusted g++; no compiler download or installation.
current_root_matrix.claim: PASS_HOST_BUILD_ONLY, not official numerical comparison or RTL.

capture_gate: M16 first, separate fresh process; only continue after its manifest and all files validate. M128 captures original complete L0 using actual same-instance cold128 then carried128 DynamicCache. Each capture has internal 120-second CPU/wall limits and 128-MiB activation limit. M16 is only cold16/carried16 and never replaces M128.

typed_full_block_replay.terminal_gate: Fresh actual_terminal.json and summary.json; status ACTUAL_COMPLETE_UNCOMPARED; 32 terminal commands; generation 2; actual same-instance cold-to-carried roots; unchanged source, fixture, Matrix, Vector and arithmetic-binding identities.
typed_full_block_replay.scope: Typed software coordinator only. Experimental exp is explicitly selected; no native PASS, production opcode, RTL, hardware-cycle, throughput or MAC-utilization claim.

comparison.gates: Current committed finite-BF16 comparator and frozen thresholds unchanged; verify every actual/native output and all source/runtime/input identities before and after. Retain FAIL or MISSING honestly; no synthetic fallback or old PASS inheritance.

required_observations: Current disk space and inode budget
Current cgroup memory limit/current usage and process limits
Existing compiler and retained dependency identities
resource_admission_before_execution.budget_note: The CLI default 1800 seconds is below historical M128 elapsed time. The explicit 3600-second compute/4000-second outer limit is a bounded proposal, not proof that current resources or changed arithmetic will complete.

completion_condition: Only a fresh qualified runtime, verified real embedding/inputs, fresh current-root Matrix receipt, fresh official M128 capture, completed real typed M128 cold/carried replay and passing unchanged final comparison close the numerical task. This plan itself closes none of those gates.
